item.description:
Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: McGovern Centennial Gardens, 1500 Hermann Drive, Houston, TX, 77004, United States

item.title: Sound Bath with Daemein Smith (Prioritizing Peace)
item.description:
Saturday, August 15, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: The Commons

Join us for a peaceful morning experience in Hermann Park with a free guided Sound Bath led by Daemein Smith of Prioritizing Peace. Set against the natural beauty of the Tsuru Family Terrace in the Commons, this immersive meditation experience uses sound and vibration to promote relaxation, mindfulness, and emotional well-being. Guests are encouraged to slow down, reset, and “Prioritize Peace” through a calming journey of sound healing in nature.  Tsuru Family Terrace Saturday, August 15  8 – 9 a.m.  Free Community Session Guests are encouraged to bring a yoga mat if available. Blankets and pillows are also recommended for additional comfort. All ages and experience levels welcome. Parking: Free parking available across the street from the Commons in Lot S (6215 Main St, Houston, TX 77030). Additional street parking available along Main Street.

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.title: September 11 National Day of Service
item.description:
Friday, September 11, 2026 at 9 AM

Location: McGovern Centennial Gardens, 1500 Hermann Drive, Houston, TX, 77004, United States

Join Hermann Park Conservancy on Friday, September 11, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. for a meaningful morning of service in Hermann Park. In recognition of the 9/11 National Day of Service and Remembrance, volunteers will unite for good by participating in hands-on projects that help care for and beautify the Park. Projects may include gardening, planting, mulching, litter removal, and other seasonal maintenance activities. Together, we will honor the spirit of service, strengthen our community, and make a lasting impact on one of Houston’s most treasured public spaces. All tools and project instructions will be provided. Sign up for a session at McGovern Centennial Gardens, the Commons, or the Heart of the Park HERE.

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.title: Kathrine McGovern Day of Service
item.description:
Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 9 AM

Location: McGovern Centennial Gardens, 1500 Hermann Drive, Houston, TX, 77004, United States

Known for her kindness and lifelong dedication to service, Kathrine G. McGovern, along with her late husband, John P. McGovern, MD, helped shape Houston into the vibrant, compassionate city it is today. On Tuesday, September 15, we invite you to celebrate her birthday by giving back to one of the places she loved most — the McGovern Centennial Gardens. Bring your friends, family, and your spirit of service. Together, we’ll honor Mrs. McGovern’s memory in the most meaningful way: by caring for the community she cherished. Volunteer with us and help continue her legacy through gardening, beautification, and stewardship projects that keep the Gardens thriving and welcoming to all. Sign up for this session in the McGovern Centennial Gardens HERE.

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.description:

Location: McGovern Centennial Gardens, 1500 Hermann Drive, Houston, TX, 77004, United States

Discover how to turn your outdoor space into a haven for local and migrating birds. Participants will learn how native plants support birds by providing essential food, shelter, and nesting resources. The program will include a guided garden walk, practical habitat-building tips, and a hands-on activity to help guests begin creating their own bird-friendly space. item.title: National Public Lands Day
item.description:
Saturday, September 26, 2026 at 9 AM

Location: McGovern Centennial Gardens, 1500 Hermann Drive, Houston, TX, 77004, United States

Join us on Saturday, September 26, for National Public Lands Day, the nation’s largest single-day volunteer event for public lands! This is your chance to give back to Hermann Park, one of Houston’s most cherished green spaces. Whether you’re pulling invasive weeds, planting native grasses or helping with trail maintenance, your time and energy will directly support the health and beauty of the park for generations to come. All ages welcome – no experience necessary! Bring your friends, family, or coworkers and help us make a lasting impact. Sign up for a session at McGovern Centennial Gardens, the Commons, or the Heart of the Park HERE.

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.title: Park to Port Bike Ride
item.description:
Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: Bayou Parkland, 6532 Almeda Rd, Houston, TX, 77021, United States

Hermann Park Conservancy’s 12th annual Park to Port Bike Ride is set for Saturday, October 24. The 20-mile round-trip bike ride takes cyclists from Hermann Park’s Bayou Parkland along the Bayou Greenway trail all the way to Mason Park, near the Port of Houston. Enjoy the turn-around party, but be sure to save some energy for a well-deserved post-ride party under the Bill Coats Bridge! Park to Port is open to riders of all skill levels and is not a race. Whether you are an experienced cyclist or are riding just for fun, you can go at your own pace on this scenic city journey. Your participation in Park to Port supports Hermann Park Conservancy and its stewardship efforts for one of Houston’s most beloved parks while promoting the ever-growing Bayou Greenway trail system. Register and learn more at the following link: 12th Annual Park to Port Bike Ride. Early bird pricing is available until August 17. SPECIAL OFFER: Save $10 on registration when you sign up for BOTH the Park to Port Bike Ride and Run in the Park! Bundle deal is available via the link above. Information on Run in the Park can be found here.

From Hermann Park Conservancy
